provenance.statement: These files are NOT captures of the real ext-apps example servers. They are hand-authored reproductions of the shapes recorded in docs/RULES.md § Measured false-positive pass. The real example servers are Vite projects whose served resource is a build output, so capturing them requires running six toolchains — see scripts/capture-reference.ts, which is the script that will replace these once a commit SHA is pinned.

must-not-fire.rule: ANY SPEC, SCHEMA or RISK finding on a fixture in this set FAILS CI.
must-not-fire.why: Small, reviewed, hash-pinned. docs/DESIGN.md §6: the corpus is a public repo, so a blanket zero-finding gate would let anyone disable a Panelint rule by landing a PR upstream.

measured.rule: A finding DEMOTES AND DOCUMENTS the rule. It does not delete the rule and it does not fail CI.
measured.why: A RISK finding on a reference server is not by definition a false positive — RISK means "permitted by the spec, expands attack surface", and a reference server may legitimately do that. PANE-CSP-008 is the live example.

corpusFacts.note: Recorded from docs/RULES.md § Measured false-positive pass. The last two lines are the poisoned-rule guards: PANE-SPEC-006 must not flag the dual-written _meta["ui/resourceUri"], and PANE-SPEC-010 must not read an absent read-level _meta.ui as a mismatch with the list-level one.

fixtures.expectation: PANE-INTEGRITY-001 at MEDIUM (below the gate) for the dynamically created CDN script with no integrity.
fixtures.notes: One of the TWO reference servers that declare _meta.ui.csp. Loads CesiumJS by creating the <script> element in JavaScript, because a static <script src> does not work inside a srcdoc iframe.

fixtures.expectation: PANE-DOM-002 at INFO for new Function. PANE-OVERLAY-001 must NOT fire on .error-overlay: it fills the viewport but declares no z-index.
fixtures.notes: new Function(...) is the app core execution mechanism, not an anomaly.

fixtures.expectation: No gate-eligible findings. The x-shader/* script blocks do not parse as JavaScript; that is a parseError on the script, never a scan failure.
fixtures.notes: GLSL in <script type="x-shader/x-fragment"> exercises the non-JS script-type path.

fixtures.expectation: PANE-CSP-008 at MEDIUM for the unpkg grant. PANE-DOM-001 must NOT fire on the eleven literal innerHTML sites. PANE-OVERLAY-001 must NOT fire on .confirm-dialog or .main.fullscreen without a second signal.
fixtures.notes: The second of the two servers declaring _meta.ui.csp. unpkg carries pdf.js and its Standard-14 fonts. Eleven innerHTML assignment sites, every one a literal.

fixtures.expectation: No gate-eligible findings. openLink with a non-literal URL is INFO-class capability disclosure.
fixtures.notes: No password field anywhere: the app states in copy that it never asks for one.
